items.title: Integration strategy defined
items.pass_criterion: The integration order, increments and dependencies are defined and consistent with the system architecture.
items.typical_defect: Big-bang integration with no order or dependency rationale.

items.title: Interface coverage by passing tests
items.pass_criterion: Every system-architecture interface has at least one integration verification measure, and each is executed and passing.
items.typical_defect: Architecture interface with no executed integration test.

items.title: Requirement coverage by passing tests
items.pass_criterion: Every system requirement has at least one verification measure with a stated method, and each is executed and passing.
items.typical_defect: System requirement with no executed verification measure.

items.title: Objective pass criteria
items.pass_criterion: Each verification measure states preconditions, stimuli, expected results and objective pass/fail criteria.
items.typical_defect: Test step "check system behaves correctly" with no expected value.

items.title: Measure selection adequate
items.pass_criterion: Selected measures cover normal, boundary and failure behaviour, including fault injection for safety mechanisms where applicable; the selection rationale is recorded.
items.typical_defect: Safety mechanism never exercised by fault injection.

items.title: Environment identified
items.pass_criterion: The verification environment (target, test bench, hardware-in-the-loop or simulation) and its configuration and versions are identified; limitations versus the real operating environment are explicit.
items.typical_defect: Simulation results reported without stating the gap to the real environment.

items.title: Results recorded and reproducible
items.pass_criterion: Actual results, verdicts and logs are recorded, tied to the configuration of the system under test, and defects are tracked.
items.typical_defect: Pass verdict that cannot be tied to the tested build or configuration.

items.title: Regression defined and applied
items.pass_criterion: A regression strategy defines which measures are re-run after a change, and the re-run results are recorded.
items.typical_defect: Element changed after verification with no regression run recorded.

items.title: Trace consistency
items.pass_criterion: Requirements and interfaces to measures to results traceability is complete and consistent in meaning.
items.typical_defect: Test linked to a requirement but verifying a different condition.

items.title: Accurate verification summary
items.pass_criterion: The summary states unverified requirements and interfaces, environment gaps and open defects accurately and makes no certification or release claim.
items.typical_defect: Summary claims full verification while requirements remain unverified.
